main_text.l: moniato, à drachmis tribus ad drach. quatuor: frigidam verò: vt, pilulis coccijs, & de agarico: quæ etiam crassam materiam à pulmonibus vacuant: Electario autem indo & diaphœnico ad vnciam dimidiam: quæ etiam calidam materiam vacuât, vti & phleboto mia, si corpus est robustum, præcalidum, sanguine abundans: aut si cynanche, aut pleuritis à tali catarrho impendet, nisi materia revellatur per venæ sectionem: aut si febris catarrho adest, quæ humores immodicè calfaciat: aliâs non facienda in catarrho sanguinis vacuatio, quia cerebrum partem exanguem & frigidam, frigidiorem reddit.

4. AVERTENTIBVS: vt, frictionibus, ligaturis extremorum, cucurbitulis in natibus, & spathulis: errhinis ex aqua violarum, vel hordei, in calida materia, quæ nares dilatent, vt viam dent liberam materiæ per has effluxuræ: in frigida autem errhinis ex aqua maioranæ, succo foliorum & radicum betæ, decocto melanthij, & his fortiore succo ireos, et cyclamini: sternutamentis etiâ

page.notes: Marginal note at right, "Mesues in cap. de catarrho." Section numeral "4." and heading AVERTENTIBVS treated as a heading; the page ends mid-sentence. Line-final "etiâ" with tilde as printed.
